datasets.name: Luding landslide dataset
datasets.verbatim: Additionally, we have labeled and published landslide samples that occurred in Luding, Sichuan Province, Southwest China, in September 2022, which is available at https://github.com/fuadou/project/tree/main/Luding_datasets.

datasets.name: GF-6 satellite images
datasets.verbatim: We construct a landslide dataset with 200 samples from GF-6 satellite images to address the scarcity of landslide data in domain generalization.

datasets.name: Sentinel-2B images
datasets.verbatim: We use the Level-1C products acquired by Sentinel-2B on October 3, 2022, at 3:35:49 A.M., which was obtained by Tile48RWT on relative orbit 061 and processed with the payload data ground station baseline 04.00.

methods.name: CAL-Net (Conditional Attention Lightweight Network)
methods.summary: CAL-Net is an end-to-end lightweight semantic segmentation network designed for in-orbit landslide detection. It uses CSPDarknet-tiny as a backbone, incorporates a Dual-stream Conditional Attention Module (DCAM) for feature refinement, a Multifeature Fusion Module (MFM) for multi-scale feature aggregation, and an Asymmetric Upsampling Module (AUM) for efficient feature recovery.
methods.verbatim: To promote reproducibility and further research, the code has been made publicly available at https://github.com/fuadou/project/tree/main/CAL-Net’code.

data_links.name: Labeled landslide samples from Luding, Sichuan Province, China (September 2022)

availability.author_statement: Published landslide samples on repository indicated in the abstract.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is provided via a public GitHub repository, and other input datasets are accessible through standard public providers. The custom code for CAL-Net is available via a provided repository link.
